SpiceJet seeks more time from Delhi High Court in Kal Airways dispute

SpiceJet has requested an extension from the Delhi High Court to deposit ₹50 crore as part of a dispute with Kal Airways. The airline stated it requires more time to settle the payment. The High Court did not interfere with the matter at this stage, allowing the proceedings to continue.
